encodings.full: designs.lcu_witness: data 0-3, selector 4; x_sign = -1 adds Z on the selector after its first H; compiled at optimization level 0 to cx, rz, h, x, z, s, sdg with Rz on the pi/64 grid
encodings.reduced: selector a = slot qubit 0, data d = slot qubit 1; SELECT = diag(g(L,L'), g(L,U'), g(U,L'), g(U,U')) over (a, d) from the census coefficients, then CNOT(a -> d); x_sign = -1 adds Z on a after its first H
encodings.reduced_cross: selector a, data d, mark w = slot qubits 0, 1, 2; identity diagonal (the census carries no phases for four-label rows, and P = 1/2 for every sign), CNOT(a -> d), CNOT(a -> w)

role: smoke run of the remote QX compile path (parser, bit order, gate set, angle grid); the exhaustive family (a) runs on Kaggle CPU through scripts/box_kite_qx_sweep.py

preregistered.observable: zero-product success P(selector = 0), counted from the selector bit of each replica
preregistered.predictions: census:design_b p_selector_zero per replica: 0 on the two zero sign choices of an edge, 1 on its other two, 1/2 on every strut, cross-kite, fixture and non-kite row
preregistered.falsifier: any shot with selector 0 on a P = 0 replica or selector 1 on a P = 1 replica refutes that circuit's implementation; a P = 1/2 replica outside |z| < 4.5 at 2048 shots refutes it
preregistered.bonferroni: the exhaustive family's bound, z_limit 4.5, applies to every P = 1/2 replica
preregistered.lcu_identity: P(x_sign) + P(-x_sign) = 1 holds by construction and checks the selector Z, not the algebra
preregistered.stop_rule: one shot violating a deterministic replica, or a P = 1/2 replica outside the bound, stops the series until the circuit is explained; each batch checks completed jobs, the shots per job and circuit digests against cases.json
